verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents agent authoring through its MCP server, which can generate infrastructure code and works with Claude Code and Cursor, and through first-class coding-agent support and Agent Skills. `pulumi preview` shows proposed changes without applying them, and it can run headlessly via the Automation API SDK or the CLI with scriptable exit codes. That covers authoring and a non-destructive plan, but the evidence never describes a dedicated approval gate or a formatted diff presented to a human before apply. missing for 10: documented approval/review step for agent-proposed changes, explicit diff presentation (e.g. PR plan comments beyond policy violations), independent hands-on corroboration of the agent-to-preview-to-approval loop.
